OWNERSHIP: all arr-* modules and their test trees. Tasks:

3. Each feature group also defines its own OkHttp command runner variant. Extract a single generic ArrCommandRunner into :arr-net and adopt it everywhere the copy is byte-identical in intent.
4. Report the count of deleted lines per module.
